sentences.zh: 这里是《隐藏的大脑》节目。

sentences.en: If you were to paint a portrait of the inner workings of your mind, what would it look like?
sentences.zh: 如果你要为自己内心的运作方式画一幅肖像，它会是什么样子？

sentences.en: Maybe you would use bright splashes of color to represent your most intense emotions.
sentences.zh: 也许你会用鲜艳的色彩来表现你最强烈的情绪。

sentences.en: Shades of gray to reflect the complexity and nuance of your thoughts.
sentences.zh: 用灰色调来反映你思想的复杂性和细微差别。

sentences.en: Swirls and spirals to express the moments when you're lost in rumination.
sentences.zh: 用漩涡和螺旋来表达你陷入沉思的时刻。

sentences.en: No one else could paint this picture.
You know yourself better than anyone else, and you are the one most attuned to your inner rhythms,
sentences.zh: 你比任何人都更了解自己，你是最能感知自己内心节奏的人，

sentences.en: your fears and insecurities, your hopes and dreaMs.
sentences.zh: 了解你的恐惧和不安，你的希望和梦想。

sentences.en: Yet, even though we may feel we are acutely aware of every corner of our mental landscapes,
sentences.zh: 然而，尽管我们可能觉得对自己精神世界的每一个角落都了如指掌，

sentences.en: it turns out many aspects of our minds are hidden from us.
sentences.zh: 但事实证明，我们思想的许多方面对我们来说是隐藏的。

sentences.en: It's almost like if you imagine a fork in the road and it just goes two different ways,
sentences.zh: 这就像你想象道路前方有一个岔路口，它通向两个不同的方向，

sentences.en: there are just two different paths here.
sentences.zh: 这里确实有两条不同的路径。

sentences.en: There's the path that we use for self-judgment, and there's the path that we use for judging others.
sentences.zh: 一条是我们用来评判自己的路径，另一条是我们用来评判他人的路径。

sentences.en: And in my view, the path that we use for judging others is we look at their actions.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，我们评判他人的路径是观察他们的行为。

sentences.en: The path that we use for judging ourselves is we look inwards.
sentences.zh: 而我们评判自己的路径则是向内审视。

sentences.en: This week on Hidden Brain, we bring you the third installment of our Mind Reading 2.0 series.
sentences.zh: 本周的《隐藏的大脑》，我们为您带来“读心术 2.0”系列的第三部分。

sentences.en: In previous episodes, we explored how we read other people's intentions
sentences.zh: 在之前的节目中，我们探讨了我们如何解读他人的意图，

sentences.en: and the social illusions that pervade everyday interpersonal relationships.
sentences.zh: 以及充斥在日常人际关系中的社会错觉。

sentences.en: Today, in a favorite episode from 2020, we look at one of the most bewildering aspects of how we read minds.
sentences.zh: 今天，在 2020 年的一期热门节目中，我们将审视我们解读思想方式中最令人困惑的方面之一。
在这种情况下，是解读我们自己的思想。

sentences.en: On a daily basis, all of us evaluate others.
sentences.zh: 我们每天都在评价他人。

sentences.en: We think about the claims of people who want to sell us something.
sentences.zh: 我们会思考那些想向我们推销东西的人所说的话。

sentences.en: We gauge the ideas of colleagues.
sentences.zh: 我们会衡量同事的想法。
我们会评估朋友和家人。

sentences.en: We also regularly look into our own hearts and minds.
sentences.zh: 我们也经常审视自己的内心和思想。

sentences.en: At Princeton University, psychologist Emily Pronin has studied
sentences.zh: 在普林斯顿大学，心理学家艾米丽·普罗宁研究了

sentences.en: why our minds come to very different conclusions about ourselves and others.
sentences.zh: 为什么我们的思想在看待自己和他人时会得出截然不同的结论。

sentences.en: Emily Pronin, welcome to Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 艾米丽·普罗宁，欢迎来到《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: So, a few years ago, Emily, you conducted an experiment where you brought volunteers into a lab
sentences.zh: 那么，艾米丽，几年前你做了一个实验，你把志愿者带到实验室，

sentences.en: and you told them about a range of different biases, biases like the halo effect,
sentences.zh: 向他们介绍了各种不同的偏见，比如光环效应，

sentences.en: where you see someone who's very beautiful and you assume this person must also be very intelligent,
sentences.zh: 即当你看到一个非常漂亮的人时，你会认为这个人一定也非常聪明，

sentences.en: or a bias like confirmation bias, where we go looking for information that supports our pre-existing views.
sentences.zh: 或者像确认偏误这样的偏见，即我们倾向于寻找支持我们既有观点的信息。

sentences.en: And you did something very interesting.
sentences.zh: 你做了一件非常有趣的事情。

sentences.en: You asked the volunteers whether they thought that they would fall prey to these biases.
sentences.zh: 你问志愿者他们是否认为自己会成为这些偏见的受害者。

sentences.en: We had students in a class so that they kind of all knew each other from being in the class together.
sentences.zh: 我们让班里的学生参与，因为他们在一起上课，彼此都比较熟悉。

sentences.en: And what we did is we described each bias just in a few sentences.
sentences.zh: 我们所做的是用几句话描述每一种偏见。

sentences.en: We didn't use the word bias.
sentences.zh: 我们没有使用“偏见”这个词。

sentences.en: We didn't want to make it sound like a negative thing so that people would say,
sentences.zh: 我们不想让它听起来像个负面词汇，以免人们说，

sentences.en: We just described it in neutral terMs.
sentences.zh: 我们只是用中性的术语来描述它。

sentences.en: And what we found is that people said, oh, gee, other people do do that.
sentences.zh: 我们发现人们会说，哦，天哪，别人确实会那样做。

sentences.en: You put that into words like that.
sentences.zh: 你用这样的语言表达出来。

sentences.en: I see that all the time.
But me, I know I don't really do that.
sentences.zh: 但至于我，我知道我真的不会那样做。

sentences.en: So what happened was people recognized the bias as something that people do,
sentences.zh: 所以发生的情况是，人们承认偏见是人们会做的事情，

sentences.en: and they attributed it to other people.
But they thought that they did it quite a bit less.
sentences.zh: 但他们认为自己这样做的情况要少得多。

sentences.en: And the same thing happens in so many different domains.
sentences.zh: 同样的事情也发生在许多不同的领域。

sentences.en: If you asked me, do you evaluate the news fairly?
sentences.zh: 如果你问我，你评价新闻公平吗？

sentences.en: Are you a good judge of policy?
sentences.zh: 你是一个好的政策评判者吗？

sentences.en: I'll tell you, of course I am.
But I can see lots of biases in the people around me.
sentences.zh: 但我能看到周围人身上有很多偏见。

sentences.en: Emily, you call this the bias blind spot.
sentences.zh: 艾米丽，你称之为“偏见盲点”。

sentences.en: What do you mean by the term?
sentences.zh: 你指的这个术语是什么意思？

sentences.en: The reason why I came to call it a bias blind spot is that a blind spot refers to a situation
sentences.zh: 我之所以称之为“偏见盲点”，是因为盲点指的是一种情况，

sentences.en: where you can see something sort of all around you except in one place.
sentences.zh: 即你可以看到周围的一切，除了某一个地方。

sentences.en: And so the blind spot is seeing the bias in yourself,
sentences.zh: 所以盲点就是看不到自己身上的偏见，

sentences.en: because it turns out that people could readily recognize these biases all around them.
sentences.zh: 因为事实证明，人们可以很容易地识别出周围的这些偏见。

sentences.en: Let's look at some specific domains where the bias blind spot affects us.
sentences.zh: 让我们看看偏见盲点影响我们的几个具体领域。

sentences.en: When it comes to ethics, we're all quick to see conflicts of interest in other people,
sentences.zh: 在道德方面，我们都能很快看到他人的利益冲突，

sentences.en: but slow to see it when it comes to ourselves.
sentences.zh: 但在涉及我们自己时却反应迟钝。
这是一个非常好的例子。

sentences.en: So, you know, doctors and gifts from the pharmaceutical industry.
sentences.zh: 比如，医生和制药行业的礼物。

sentences.en: So people have studied this and doctors will say,
sentences.zh: 人们研究过这个问题，医生们会说，

sentences.en: And oftentimes the gifts are small, right?
sentences.zh: 而且通常礼物都很小，对吧？

sentences.en: They're like you have a Pfizer pen.
sentences.zh: 比如你有一支辉瑞的笔。

sentences.en: Sometimes the gifts are rather large.
Like, we'd love to hear you come and give a talk on your research,
sentences.zh: 比如，我们很想听你来谈谈你的研究，

sentences.en: you know, in the Caribbean, you know,
sentences.zh: 你知道，在加勒比海，你知道，

sentences.en: we'll fly you over there, you know, in a private jet to give your talk.
sentences.zh: 我们会用私人飞机把你接过去做演讲。

sentences.en: And I credit to the medical industry that I think,
sentences.zh: 我认为医疗行业值得称赞的是，

sentences.en: you know, they have really worked on trying to root this out
sentences.zh: 他们确实在努力根除这种现象，

sentences.en: because they recognized it as a problem.
sentences.zh: 因为他们认识到这是一个问题。

sentences.en: So there's no longer free lunches for residents every day,
sentences.zh: 据我所知，现在住院医生不再每天都有免费午餐了，

sentences.en: you know, sponsored by various drug companies, as far as I understand.
sentences.zh: 你知道，由各种制药公司赞助的那种。

sentences.en: But the point being, the doctors said that they were not influenced by these gifts,
sentences.zh: 但重点是，医生们说他们没有受到这些礼物的影响，
但其他医生会受到影响。

sentences.en: So it's a perfect example of a conflict of interest
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个完美的例子，说明了利益冲突

sentences.en: not being recognized in self, but seen in others.
sentences.zh: 在自己身上无法识别，但在他人身上却显而易见。

sentences.en: The bias blind spot also affects how we think we are affected by marketing
sentences.zh: 偏见盲点也影响我们认为自己如何受到营销的影响，

sentences.en: and how we think others are affected by marketing.
sentences.zh: 以及我们认为他人如何受到营销的影响。

sentences.en: I want to play you a clip for an ad that I recently came by.
sentences.zh: 我想给你播放一段我最近看到的广告片段。
GLH 的意思是“看起来很棒的头发”。

sentences.en: Just spray GLH on and it instantly covers your bald spot,
sentences.zh: 只需喷上 GLH，它就能瞬间覆盖你的秃斑，
让你拥有一头看起来很棒的头发。

sentences.en: GLH is not a paint or a cover-up.
sentences.zh: GLH 不是油漆或遮盖物。

sentences.en: It's an amazing powder that clings to the tiniest hairs on your head.
sentences.zh: 它是一种神奇的粉末，能附着在你头上最细小的头发上。

sentences.en: So that was an ad for spray-on hair.
sentences.zh: 那是一个喷雾生发产品的广告。

sentences.en: Now, I don't think I'm influenced by advertising,
sentences.zh: 我不认为我受到广告的影响，

sentences.en: whether that's commercial advertising or political advertising,
sentences.zh: 无论是商业广告还是政治广告，

sentences.en: but I think other people are quite vulnerable to such persuasion.
sentences.zh: 但我认为其他人很容易受到这种说服的影响。

sentences.en: Yeah, there's a phenomenon called the third-person effect,
sentences.zh: 是的，有一种现象叫“第三人效应”，

sentences.en: whereby people think that persuasive attempts
sentences.zh: 即人们认为说服性的尝试

sentences.en: have more of an impact on other people than themselves.
sentences.zh: 对他人的影响比对自己更大。

sentences.en: So they say, oh, commercials, you know, political ads,
sentences.zh: 所以他们会说，哦，商业广告，你知道，政治广告，

sentences.en: I'm sort of immune to them.
Whereas people recognize it's a whole industry, you know,
sentences.zh: 然而人们承认这是一个完整的行业，你知道，

sentences.en: but we see others as more susceptible to these influences than ourselves.
sentences.zh: 但我们认为他人比我们自己更容易受到这些影响。

sentences.en: How does this work in politics?
sentences.zh: 这在政治中是如何运作的？

sentences.en: When we evaluate our political opponents,
sentences.zh: 当我们评估政治对手时，

sentences.en: how does this bias sort of play out in our evaluations,
sentences.zh: 这种偏见是如何在我们的评估中体现出来的，

sentences.en: both of people on our side and people on the other side?
sentences.zh: 无论是对我们阵营的人，还是对另一阵营的人？

sentences.en: Yeah, so that's a great question.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是一个很好的问题。

sentences.en: And obviously, we've all been thinking about it a lot recently.
sentences.zh: 显然，我们最近都在思考这个问题。

sentences.en: So I think there's a lot of things that are going on.
sentences.zh: 我认为有很多因素在起作用。

sentences.en: One is, what do I believe are the roots of my political opinions
sentences.zh: 一是，我认为我的政治观点和政治信仰的根源是什么？
人们会发誓说他们的政治信仰的根源

sentences.en: And people will swear that the roots of their political beliefs
sentences.zh: 仅仅是对问题的理性分析，对吧？

sentences.en: are just an irrational analysis of the issue, right?
sentences.zh: 所以我持现在的立场，因为那是正确的立场。

sentences.en: So I take the positions I do because those are the correct positions.
sentences.zh: 如果你分析这些问题，如果你分析国家的状况，

sentences.en: If you analyze the issues, if you analyze the state of the country,
sentences.zh: 如果你思考什么对国家最有利，

sentences.en: if you think about what's best for the nation,

sentences.zh: 但他们并不认为这是对方立场产生的根源。

sentences.en: But they don't view that as being the root
sentences.zh: 所以另一方是受到意识形态、

sentences.en: to the positions of those on the other side.
sentences.zh: 自身利益、偏见，无论是什么的影响。

sentences.en: So the other side is influenced by ideology,
sentences.zh: 你知道，我一直在想这个，

sentences.en: by self-interest, by prejudice, whatever it is.
sentences.zh: 前段时间出炉的一项研究，

sentences.en: You know, I was thinking about this,
sentences.zh: 那是在奥巴马总统任期内。

sentences.en: the study that came out some time ago,
and this was during the Obama presidency.

sentences.zh: 总统对高油价或低油价负有多大责任？

sentences.en: And people were asking, you know,
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，同一个小组在乔治·W·布什总统任期内

sentences.en: how much is the president responsible for high gas prices or low gas prices?
sentences.zh: 也向公民问过同样的问题，

sentences.en: And what was interesting is that the same group had asked the question
to citizens during the presidency of George W.
sentences.zh: 令人着迷且或许并不令人惊讶的是，当然，
当油价高涨且白宫里住着共和党人时，

sentences.en: when also gas prices were high.
sentences.zh: 大多数共和党人认为总统对油价几乎没有控制权，

sentences.en: And what's fascinating and perhaps unsurprising is, of course,
sentences.zh: 因此不应为此受到指责。

sentences.en: when gas prices are high and there's a Republican in the White House,
sentences.zh: 而民主党人则认为总统对油价有很大控制权，

sentences.en: most Republicans think the president has very little control over gas prices
and therefore should not be blamed for it.
sentences.zh: 当白宫里住着民主党人时，情况完全反过来了。

sentences.en: And Democrats think the president has a lot of control over gas prices
sentences.zh: 所以在两种情况下，人们都以一种非常自私的方式，

sentences.en: and should be blamed for it.
sentences.zh: 看待他们所掌握的数据。

sentences.en: And the tables are exactly turned when you have a Democrat in the White House.
sentences.zh: 而这正是偏见盲点在现实世界中的体现。

sentences.en: And so in both cases, people in a very self-interested way
sentences.zh: 我们总是倾向于认为自己的观点是客观的，

sentences.en: see the data that they have
sentences.zh: 而他人的观点则是带有偏见的。

sentences.en: and interpret it in a way that aligns with their political beliefs.
sentences.zh: 并以符合他们政治信仰的方式来解读它。

sentences.en: And of course, this is just one example.
There must be hundreds of examples like this.
sentences.zh: 这样的例子肯定有成百上千个。

sentences.en: And what's amazing is it's motivated reasoning.
sentences.zh: 令人惊奇的是，这是一种动机性推理。

sentences.en: And both of those words are important, right?
sentences.zh: 这两个词都很重要，对吧？

sentences.en: I'm seeing things in a way that's consistent, right,
sentences.zh: 我以一种前后一致的方式看待事物，对吧，

sentences.en: with my motives, my prior beliefs.
sentences.zh: 符合我的动机，符合我先入为主的观念。

sentences.en: But it's also reasoning because they're not just saying,
sentences.zh: 但它也是“推理”，因为他们不仅仅是在说，

sentences.en: well, I'm just going to believe whatever makes my side look better.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我就是要相信任何能让我这一方看起来更好的东西。

sentences.en: That would be just like pure motivation.

sentences.zh: 这里面确实存在推理过程。

sentences.en: So people are actually stopping to think,
sentences.zh: 所以人们实际上是在停下来思考，

sentences.en: okay, well, what are the factors that influence gas prices
sentences.zh: 好吧，影响汽油价格的因素有哪些，

sentences.en: and who might be responsible for
and what's going on on the global political stage, you know?
sentences.zh: 全球政治舞台上发生了什么，你知道吗？

sentences.en: And so if you reason it out,
these things are so complex that you can find reasons for almost anything
sentences.zh: 这些事情非常复杂，你几乎可以为任何事情找到理由，

sentences.en: or at least for one of the two sides of the issue anyway.
sentences.zh: 或者至少能为问题的一方找到理由。

sentences.en: There is another curious dimension of the bias blind spot.
sentences.zh: 偏见盲点还有一个有趣的维度。

sentences.en: When we come up with positions on various issues,
sentences.zh: 当我们对各种问题形成立场时，

sentences.en: we're keenly aware of the nuances and subtleties of our opinions,
sentences.zh: 我们敏锐地意识到自己观点的细微差别和复杂性，

sentences.en: but we don't extend the same respect to the views of our opponents.
sentences.zh: 但我们却不以同样的尊重去对待对手的观点。

sentences.en: We very rarely say the views of the people who disagree with me
sentences.zh: 我们很少会说那些不同意我的人的观点
是深思熟虑且微妙的，对吧？

sentences.en: I think that there's more of a tendency to sort of stereotype
sentences.zh: 我认为人们有一种倾向，去刻板印象化

sentences.en: and to recognize the nuance and complexity in our own views.
sentences.zh: 却能识别出自己观点中的细微差别和复杂性。

sentences.en: And unfortunately, the political realm, I think, affords that,
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，我认为政治领域助长了这一点，
让这种情况更有可能发生，

sentences.en: because people can't really express their own ambivalences and nuances, right?
sentences.zh: 因为人们无法真正表达自己的矛盾心理和细微差别，对吧？

sentences.en: Because that scene is sort of giving into the other side.
sentences.zh: 因为那看起来就像是向对方妥协。

sentences.en: So people do tend to portray themselves as sort of more clear
sentences.zh: 所以人们确实倾向于把自己表现得更清晰，

sentences.en: and perhaps even more extreme in that respect as a result.
sentences.zh: 甚至在这一方面表现得更极端。

sentences.en: We've known for a long time that our evaluations of ourselves
sentences.zh: 我们早就知道，我们对自己和他人的评价

sentences.en: are very different than our evaluations of others.
The Bible asks why we notice a speck of dust in our brother's eye
sentences.zh: 《圣经》问为什么我们能注意到兄弟眼中的尘埃，

sentences.en: but ignore the beam sticking out of our own eye.
sentences.zh: 却忽略了自己眼中的梁木。

sentences.en: When we come back, the psychological quirk
sentences.zh: 回来后，我们将探讨产生这种心理怪癖的原因，

sentences.en: that produces the radically different judgments we make
sentences.zh: 它导致了我们对自己和他人
您正在收听的是《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: All of us find it remarkably easy
sentences.zh: 我们所有人都觉得非常容易

sentences.en: to identify bias among other people,

sentences.zh: 尤其是我们对手的偏见。

sentences.en: And all of us find it maddeningly difficult
sentences.zh: 但我们所有人都觉得极其困难
心理学家艾米丽·普罗宁

sentences.en: has spent years studying this discrepancy
sentences.zh: 多年来一直致力于研究这种认知上的差异，
她发现这种差异很大程度上

sentences.en: and she has found that much of the discrepancy
sentences.zh: 归结于我们在评价自己和他人时
